Invivyd continues to expect top-line data from the VYD2311 program around the end of Q3 2026.

At that time, Invivyd plans to either unblind the DECLARATION study in its entirety and submit a Biologics License Application (BLA) towards traditional product approval, or partially unblind the study (leaving clinical events blinded) and submit a BLA towards Accelerated Approval on the basis of antiviral activity and safety, with greater statistical power expected to be achieved in a post-approval confirmatory clinical cohort.
